notes.title: New update V 3.13.010
notes.notes:
A larger update was in the works, but there were a few things that seemed critical, so a smaller update has been released first.

Patch notes :
[list]
  [*] Fixed a bug in the custom card generator that could result in the play ability that grants shields to allies to be created with incorrect values.
  [*] Fixed an error in the calculation of XP gains for victories in gate areas, causing it to drop to low amounts for very high area levels.
  [*] Fixed a minor error in the calculation of XP gains for defeats in various game modes.
  [*] Fixed a crash that occurred when trying to bring up the card popup for gate opponents on an opponent's info screen.
  [*] Fixed a bug that could result in Elemental Destroyer its play ability destroying more than one ship in rare cases.
  [*] Star Drone's play ability now grants it 20% AMC per ship instead of 10%.
  [*] Technomind's card cost has been removed.
  [*] Excession's attack has been lowered from 5 to 4.
  [*] Hydranought's defense has been increased from 36 to 40.
  [*] Greater Grav Demon's defense has been increased from 32 to 36.
  [*] Antimatter Weaponry now grants 2 attack to all ships (up from 1) and costs 4 (up from 2).

[/list]

notes.title: New update V 3.13.009
notes.notes:
This update wraps up the recently added sets of new cards. The shipcards from those sets now have matching mercenary cards as well as mercenary bosses.

This update also adds background infos to a few more cards.

notes.title: Another 12 new cards for HD3
notes.notes:
HD3 version 3.13.008 adds the second half of the set of new cards. 12 cards with matching opponents in the tactical game mode are now available. This set consists of 8 dual-color cards and 4 artifact cards.

The previous set of 12 cards is still available from the related tactical opponents, but these cards can now also drop from regular duels, or be selected as rewards from exploration.

This update also includes a couple minor bugfixes, and adds background story texts to the following cards : Vector, Nagato, Akata, Hiraga, Venom, Vulture, Firewing, Aladayr's Phoenix, Troy, Siege Engine, Hiroto, 4th Moon of Xyth.

notes.title: HD3 updated with 12 new cards.
notes.notes:
HD3 version 3.13.007 adds 12 new cards to the game. Temporarily (for approx 2 weeks) these cards can only be gotten from the 12 new opponents that have been added to the 'Tactical' game mode.

These 12 cards include 1 card for each race and 4 Artifact cards. This is half of a larger set of new cards. The other half will be released in the near future (approx 2 weeks from now).
24 new abilities are introduced with this card set, and they've all been added to the custom card generator. Thus, game modes that support custom cards will have even more variation in the generated cards.

This update also includes a few minor corrections to the custom card generator, making sure that a few less common abilities actually have a chance of appearing on cards.

notes.title: HD3 released!
notes.notes:
Hidden Dimensions 3 is now available on Steam.

Savegames from the beta of the game are compatible, and they use the same folder. If you've played the android version, you can transfer your savegame data over using the in-game account system.

Steam achievements have been added for all tier 4 achievements in-game.
